whenToUse: People sign in to an account with an email or username.
Password managers should be able to fill it.
Returning users should get in quickly.
whenNotToUse: Services that sign up only with social accounts (use social sign-in).
You'd block features that work without signing in.
You'd push newcomers to sign in before signing up.

alternatives.name: Social Sign-in
alternatives.reason: Getting in directly with an outside account.

accessibility: Set autocomplete to username and current-password so password managers can fill them.
Errors are read with role="alert", and both fields are tied to them with aria-invalid and aria-describedby.
Show password is a button with aria-pressed.
